code: const favKey=(type,userId)=>"lebux_fav_".concat(type,"_").concat(userId||'anon');export function getFavoriteIds(type,userId){try{const raw=localStorage.getItem(favKey(type,userId));if(!raw)return[];return JSON.parse(raw||'[]');}catch(_unused){return[];}}export function toggleFavorite(type,userId,id){try{const key=favKey(type,userId);const current=getFavoriteIds(type,userId);const exists=current.includes(id);const next=exists?current.filter(x=>x!==id):[...current,id];localStorage.setItem(key,JSON.stringify(next));return next;}catch(_unused2){return[];}}export function isFavorited(type,userId,id){try{return getFavoriteIds(type,userId).includes(id);}catch(_unused3){return false;}}
